component.name: Relay
component.summary: Terminal with a rich prompt and bring-your-own-key agents

description.p: Relay has its own terminal engine and adds a real text editor for composing commands: mouse selection, multi-line editing, undo and history. The same prompt sends natural-language requests to an agent that runs on your own API key with any OpenAI-compatible provider.

ul.li: A full terminal emulator, with tabs, splits and native input when a program needs it
Automatic routing between the shell and the agent, with explicit overrides
Agent tool calls, commands and file diffs shown inline in the terminal
Folder explorer and file preview panes
API keys kept in the desktop keyring; no accounts and no telemetry

description.p: Relay is beta software. Agent tools currently run without a per-action approval step.

screenshot.caption: Agent tool calls and file diffs inline in the terminal
Split panes, each with its own prompt
Folder explorer and file preview panes

description.p: Open a pane another of your Relays shares, inside the app; a friend joins a shared pane with a meeting code and a PIN; Relay Free works out of the box.
